papers.title: Telomere Maintenance Is Acquired at Liposarcoma Dedifferentiation, and Genetically Longer Telomeres Are Associated With Liposarcoma Risk
papers.translated_title: 端粒维持是在脂肪肉瘤去分化过程中获得的，而遗传上较长的端粒与脂肪肉瘤风险相关
papers.author: Pan, M.
papers.summary: PURPOSE The impact of telomere length, telomerase gene alterations and alternative lengthening of the telomere in sarcoma subtypes remains unclear. METHODS We have analyzed 11,792 patients with sarcoma next-generation sequencing performed across 19 centers in AACR Project GENIE v20.0. Telomerase activation was defined as TERT promoter mutation, amplification, or rearrangement, and ATRX/DAXX inactivation served as the ALT proxy. Findings were tested for TERT expression in The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), for overall survival (OS) in MSK-IMPACT 50K, and for replication in an independent Foundation Medicine cohort. Mendelian randomization (MR) in FinnGen tested germline telomere length. RESULTS Telomerase activation (8.8%) and ATRX/DAXX loss (8.0%) were mutually exclusive across subtypes (odds ratio [OR], 0.52; 95% CI, 0.29 to 0.92) and segregated by histology. In MDM2-amplified dedifferentiated liposarcoma (DDLPS), telomerase was activated through TERT amplification (17.2%) or rearrangement (2.7%), never promoter mutation (0/261), and never with ATRX/DAXX loss (0/49; P = .011). TERT-amplified tumors expressed TERT (TCGA; P = .002), and amplification was largely focal. Telomere maintenance alterations were present in 28.0% of DDLPS versus 8.7% of well-differentiated liposarcoma (P < .001) and predicted shorter OS in DDLPS (hazard ratio, 2.04; 95% CI, 1.23 to 3.39; P = .005). ATRX/DAXX loss was more frequent in uterine than extrauterine leiomyosarcoma in GENIE (adjusted OR, 1.96) and in the independent cohort (OR, 1.95; both P < .001). Genetically longer telomeres were associated with liposarcoma (OR per SD, 4.10; 95% CI, 2.15 to 7.81). CONCLUSION Sarcoma telomere maintenance is histology-specific, telomerase activation and ALT are mutually exclusive. In liposarcoma it is acquired at dedifferentiation through focal TERT amplification or ALT and identifies DDLPS with inferior survival. Long telomere was associated with elevated risk of liposarcoma genetically.
papers.translated_summary: 目的 端粒长度、端粒酶基因改变及端粒替代延长机制在肉瘤亚型中的影响仍不明确。方法 我们分析了AACR Project GENIE v20.0中19个中心开展的下一代测序所涉及的11,792例肉瘤患者。端粒酶激活定义为TERT启动子突变、扩增或重排，ATRX/DAXX失活作为ALT的替代指标。研究结果在The Cancer Genome Atlas（TCGA）中检测TERT表达，在MSK-IMPACT 50K中检测总生存期（OS），并在独立的Foundation Medicine队列中进行验证。在FinnGen中进行孟德尔随机化（MR）以检测胚系端粒长度。结果 端粒酶激活（8.8%）与ATRX/DAXX缺失（8.0%）在各亚型中互斥（比值比[OR]，0.52；95% CI，0.29至0.92），并按组织学类型分离。在MDM2扩增的去分化脂肪肉瘤（DDLPS）中，端粒酶通过TERT扩增（17.2%）或重排（2.7%）被激活，从未出现启动子突变（0/261），也从未伴随ATRX/DAXX缺失（0/49；P = .011）。TERT扩增的肿瘤表达TERT（TCGA；P = .002），且扩增主要为局灶性。端粒维持改变在DDLPS中占28.0%，而在高分化脂肪肉瘤中占8.7%（P < .001），并预测DDLPS的OS较短（风险比，2.04；95% CI，1.23至3.39；P = .005）。在GENIE中，ATRX/DAXX缺失在子宫平滑肌肉瘤中比子宫外平滑肌肉瘤更常见（校正OR，1.96），在独立队列中亦然（OR，1.95；均P < .001）。遗传学上较长的端粒与脂肪肉瘤相关（每SD的OR，4.10；95% CI，2.15至7.81）。结论 肉瘤端粒维持具有组织学特异性，端粒酶激活与ALT互斥。在脂肪肉瘤中，端粒维持机制在去分化过程中通过局灶性TERT扩增或ALT获得，并可识别生存较差的DDLPS。遗传学上长端粒与脂肪肉瘤风险升高相关。

papers.title: Real-world cardiovascular effects of liraglutide: transportability analysis of the LEADER trial
papers.translated_title: 利拉鲁肽的真实世界心血管效应：LEADER试验的可移植性分析
papers.author: Josey, K. P.
papers.summary: Appropriate use of recently approved type 2 diabetes treatments depends on the external validity of landmark randomized clinical trials (RCTs) in real-world populations that may differ from trial participants. This study transported effect estimates from the Liraglutide Effect and Action in Diabetes: Evaluation of Cardiovascular Outcome Results (LEADER) trial, a placebo-controlled RCT of liraglutide on cardiovascular outcomes, onto real-world cohorts within the Veterans Affairs (VA) healthcare system. Risk differences (RDs) in survival outcomes, approximated using pseudo-observations of individual survival probabilities, were estimated with augmented inverse probability weighting after balancing baseline characteristics between RCT and target samples using approximate balancing weights. Transported effects of liraglutide compared with placebo on major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) and all-cause mortality in veterans (VA-weighted LEADER) were larger than, though statistically consistent with, the treatment effects observed in LEADER: MACE RD at 3 years of 4.6% (95% CI, 2.2, 7.0) in VA-weighted LEADER vs 1.6% (0.3, 2.9) in LEADER; all-cause mortality RD at 3 years of 2.9% (0.8, 5.1) in VA-weighted LEADER vs 0.9% (-0.1, 1.9) in LEADER. These estimates of the effects of liraglutide in veterans with diabetes provide real-world evidence that can guide diabetes treatment decisions and formulary policies for a high-risk population underrepresented in RCTs.
papers.translated_summary: 近期获批的2型糖尿病治疗药物的合理使用取决于标志性随机临床试验（RCT）在真实世界人群中的外部有效性，而真实世界人群可能与试验参与者存在差异。本研究将利拉鲁肽心血管结局评价（LEADER）试验——一项关于利拉鲁肽对心血管结局影响的安慰剂对照RCT——的效应估计迁移至退伍军人事务部（VA）医疗系统内的真实世界队列。在利用近似平衡权重使RCT与目标样本的基线特征达到平衡后，采用增强逆概率加权法估计生存结局的风险差（RD），该风险差通过个体生存概率的伪观测值近似获得。利拉鲁肽与安慰剂相比对退伍军人主要不良心血管事件（MACE）和全因死亡率的影响（VA加权LEADER）大于LEADER中观察到的治疗效果，但在统计学上一致：VA加权LEADER中3年MACE风险差为4.6%（95% CI，2.2，7.0），而LEADER中为1.6%（0.3，2.9）；VA加权LEADER中3年全因死亡率风险差为2.9%（0.8，5.1），而LEADER中为0.9%（-0.1，1.9）。这些关于利拉鲁肽在退伍军人糖尿病患者中效应的估计提供了真实世界证据，可为这一在RCT中代表性不足的高风险人群的糖尿病治疗决策和处方集政策提供指导。

papers.title: Subjective social status is associated with depressive symptoms beyond objective socioeconomic status among Chinese residents: a cross-sectional study
papers.translated_title: 中国居民的主观社会地位与抑郁症状相关，且这种关联超出客观社会经济地位的影响：一项横断面研究
papers.author: Han, Y.
papers.summary: Background: Socioeconomic status is strongly associated with depressive symptoms, but whether this reflects material conditions or perceived position is unclear. We tested whether subjective social status relates to symptoms independently of objective SES. Methods: Using the 2022 Psychology and Behavior Investigation of Chinese Residents (PBICR2022), we analyzed 19,048 community residents. Objective SES was built by principal component analysis from income, education, employment, and housing. Subjective status was measured with a 7-point item and depressive symptoms with the Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9). Analyses used hierarchical regression, bootstrap mediation, moderated mediation, and response surface analysis. Results: Probable depression prevalence was 21.77%. Subjective status was inversely associated with symptoms ({beta} = -0.098). Objective SES showed no overall association (total effect = -0.009, p = .30), with a weak protective association only among adults ([≥] 18 years; -0.025, p = .004). Its protective value operated through subjective status: higher objective status went with higher identification, and higher identification with fewer symptoms (indirect effect = -0.020, 95% CI [-0.024, -0.016]). This channel was stronger in never-married than married adults (difference = -0.015, 95% CI [-0.026, -0.003]), though non-significant in stratified tests, thus suggestive. Never-married adults may lack this social validation and rely more on self-rated standing. No sex or migration differences appeared. Subjective status outweighed objective conditions, protection leveling off at high status. Conclusions: Subjective status was more closely linked to symptoms than objective conditions, whose value operated mainly through raised subjective status. Cross-sectional design precludes causal inference.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：社会经济地位与抑郁症状密切相关，但这种关联反映的是物质条件还是主观地位感知尚不清楚。我们检验了主观社会地位是否独立于客观社会经济地位而与症状相关。方法：利用2022年中国居民心理与行为调查（PBICR2022），我们分析了19，048名社区居民。客观社会经济地位由收入、教育、就业和住房通过主成分分析构建。主观地位采用7点条目测量，抑郁症状采用患者健康问卷-9（PHQ-9）测量。分析采用层次回归、Bootstrap中介分析、有调节的中介分析和响应面分析。结果：可能抑郁的患病率为21.77%。主观地位与症状呈负相关（β = -0.098）。客观社会经济地位总体上无关联（总效应 = -0.009，p = .30），仅在成年人（≥18岁）中呈现微弱的保护性关联（-0.025，p = .004）。其保护价值通过主观地位发挥作用：客观地位越高，认同感越高，认同感越高，症状越少（间接效应 = -0.020，95% CI [-0.024, -0.016]）。这一通道在从未结婚的成年人中强于已婚成年人（差异 = -0.015，95% CI [-0.026, -0.003]），但在分层检验中不显著，因此仅为提示性。从未结婚的成年人可能缺乏这种社会认可，更多依赖自我评价的地位。未发现性别或迁移差异。主观地位的重要性超过客观条件，保护作用在高地位时趋于平缓。结论：主观地位与症状的关联比客观条件更为密切，客观条件的价值主要通过提升主观地位发挥作用。横断面设计限制了因果推断。

papers.title: How much is enough? Optimising sampling frames for genomic surveillance of Escherichia coli and Klebsiella spp. bloodstream infections - a retrospective study
papers.translated_title: 多少才足够？优化大肠杆菌和克雷伯菌属血流感染基因组监测的采样框架——一项回顾性研究
papers.author: Nagy, D.
papers.summary: Background: Optimising sampling frames for genomic surveillance of E. coli and Klebsiella may support interventions to mitigate bloodstream infections (BSIs), but approaches to estimating sample size and how these relate to bacterial population diversity at multiple genetic levels (strain/plasmid/antimicrobial resistance genes [ARGs]) are lacking. Methods: Using systematically collected, regionally-stratified, whole genome sequencing data from a 6-month genomic survey of English E. coli/Klebsiella BSI isolates (n=1,939; NEKSUS), we used Bayesian approaches to estimate the sample sizes required to capture genetic diversity at strain- (MLST, fastBAPS clusters), plasmid- and ARG-levels, using two diversity measures: 'coverage' (i.e. proportion of the bacterial population/plasmids/ARGs represented by features observed in the sample), and the number/proportion of unique features observed at varying surveillance sample sizes. Our method is available as a user-friendly R Shiny application, EpiSENTRY (https://01a0c3dd-90d2-e597-58a5-51391a468387.share.connect.posit.cloud/). Findings: Randomly sampling 1,400 E. coli/Klebsiella BSI isolates each achieved [≥]80% coverage of bacterial lineages and ARGs (i.e. capture features constituting [≥]80% of the population) at 95% certainty, but captured lower proportions of unique features (28% MLSTs, 59% fastBAPS clusters, 19% plasmid subcommunities, and 57% ARGs for E. coli; 49%, 87%, 50% and 83% for Klebsiella, respectively). Sample sizes required for 80% coverage of E. coli plasmid populations were higher than MLSTs (1,928 [95% CrI: 1,837-2,025] vs 1,351 [1,230-1,472]), while for Klebsiella, estimates were lower for plasmids (1,115 [1,052-1,181] vs 1,422 [1,331-1,515] for MLSTs). Lower sample sizes adequately captured 80% coverage of fastBAPS clusters and ARGs (649 [575-727] and 27 [23-30], respectively, for E. coli; 113 [84-145] and 83 [72-96] for Klebsiella), due to feature-specific frequency distributions. Klebsiella BSIs were more diverse than E. coli, with sampling 10.9% vs 3.2% of total annual BSIs in England needed to reach 80% MLST coverage. Plasmid populations and Klebsiella MLSTs were region-specific, emphasising the need for regionally-representative sampling. Interpretation: Bayesian analysis facilitates estimates of context-specific genomic surveillance sample sizes. Cost-effective targets for coverage require further optimisation.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：优化大肠杆菌和克雷伯菌基因组监测的抽样框架可能有助于支持减轻血流感染（BSIs）的干预措施，但估算样本量的方法以及这些方法与细菌种群在多个遗传层面（菌株/质粒/抗菌药物耐药基因[ARGs]）多样性之间的关系尚缺乏。方法：利用来自为期6个月的英格兰大肠杆菌/克雷伯菌BSI分离株基因组调查（n=1,939；NEKSUS）的系统收集、区域分层全基因组测序数据，我们使用贝叶斯方法估算捕获菌株层面（MLST、fastBAPS聚类）、质粒层面和ARG层面遗传多样性所需的样本量，采用两种多样性度量：“覆盖度”（即样本中观察到的特征所代表的细菌种群/质粒/ARGs比例），以及在不同监测样本量下观察到的独特特征的数量/比例。我们的方法以用户友好的R Shiny应用程序EpiSENTRY提供（https://01a0c3dd-90d2-e597-58a5-51391a468387.share.connect.posit.cloud/）。发现：随机抽取1,400株大肠杆菌/克雷伯菌BSI分离株各自在95%确定性下达到细菌谱系和ARGs的≥80%覆盖度（即捕获构成种群≥80%的特征），但捕获的独特特征比例较低（大肠杆菌为28%的MLST、59%的fastBAPS聚类、19%的质粒亚群落和57%的ARGs；克雷伯菌分别为49%、87%、50%和83%）。大肠杆菌质粒种群达到80%覆盖度所需的样本量高于MLST（1,928 [95% CrI：1,837-2,025] vs 1,351 [1,230-1,472]），而克雷伯菌的质粒估计值较低（1,115 [1,052-1,181] vs MLST的1,422 [1,331-1,515]）。较低的样本量即可充分达到fastBAPS聚类和ARGs的80%覆盖度（大肠杆菌分别为649 [575-727]和27 [23-30]；克雷伯菌为113 [84-145]和83 [72-96]），这是由于特征特定的频率分布。克雷伯菌BSIs比大肠杆菌更多样，需要抽取英格兰年度BSIs总数的10.9% vs 3.2%才能达到80% MLST覆盖度。质粒种群和克雷伯菌MLST具有区域特异性，强调需要具有区域代表性的抽样。解释：贝叶斯分析有助于估算特定背景下的基因组监测样本量。具有成本效益的覆盖度目标需要进一步优化。

papers.title: Human Islet Transcriptomics in Type 2 Diabetes Reveals Conserved Dysfunction Axes and a Candidate Gene Panel
papers.translated_title: 2型糖尿病中的人类胰岛转录组学揭示了保守的功能障碍轴和一个候选基因组合
papers.author: Romero, R.
papers.summary: Background. Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2D) involves progressive pancreatic beta-cell dysfunction, but conserved islet programs require cross-cohort and single-cell validation. Methods. We integrated four human islet transcriptomic cohorts using differential expression, random-effects meta-analysis, Hallmark scoring, and module scoring. To test generalizability without reusing held-out outcomes, modules were re-derived from three cohorts and scored in the fourth in rotating study-level cross-fitting, with expression- and detection-matched random gene-set nulls. Machine-learning performance in GSE164416 was estimated by nested stratified 5-fold cross-validation with DEG calling and feature selection repeated within each outer training fold. An annotation-compatible score was tested in GSE50244, and beta-cell validation used GSE221156. Results. Cross-fitted IsletDysfunctionScore effects were positive in all four held-out cohorts (d = 0.39-1.36; pooled Hedges g = 0.905, 95% CI 0.501-1.309, p = 1.14 x 10^-5, I2 = 5.5%). Matched gene-set null testing supported effects beyond random expectation in two cohorts. Nested machine learning yielded AUC = 0.960 (bootstrap 95% CI 0.900-0.997); GABRA2 and ENSG00000284653 were selected in all outer folds. The external 8-gene consensus-pool score achieved AUC = 0.907 (DeLong 95% CI 0.818-0.996), but its fixed threshold did not transfer. In GSE221156, the single-cell dysfunction-score analog increased and BetaIdentitySecretion decreased in T2D; ImmuneStress was nominally increased but did not survive false-discovery correction across the single-cell score family. Conclusions. Human T2D islets show a reproducible stress/identity-loss framework that generalizes directionally under study-level cross-fitting and beta-cell-resolved validation. The candidate panel is a research transcriptomic signature requiring further validation.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。2型糖尿病（T2D）涉及进行性胰岛β细胞功能障碍，但保守的胰岛程序需要跨队列和单细胞验证。方法。我们整合了四个人类胰岛转录组队列，使用差异表达、随机效应荟萃分析、Hallmark评分和模块评分。为在不重复使用留出结局的情况下检验可推广性，模块从三个队列中重新推导，并在第四个队列中评分，采用轮换的研究级交叉拟合，并使用表达和检测匹配的随机基因集零模型。GSE164416中的机器学习性能通过嵌套分层5折交叉验证估计，差异表达基因（DEG）识别和特征选择在每个外层训练折内重复进行。在GSE50244中测试了注释兼容评分，β细胞验证使用GSE221156。结果。交叉拟合的IsletDysfunctionScore效应在所有四个留出队列中均为阳性（d = 0.39-1.36；合并Hedges g = 0.905，95% CI 0.501-1.309，p = 1.14 x 10^-5，I2 = 5.5%）。匹配基因集零模型检验在两个队列中支持效应超出随机预期。嵌套机器学习得出AUC = 0.960（bootstrap 95% CI 0.900-0.997）；GABRA2和ENSG00000284653在所有外层折中均被选中。外部8基因共识池评分达到AUC = 0.907（DeLong 95% CI 0.818-0.996），但其固定阈值未能迁移。在GSE221156中，单细胞功能障碍评分类似物在T2D中升高，BetaIdentitySecretion降低；ImmuneStress名义上升高，但在单细胞评分家族的多重检验校正后未能保留显著性。结论。人类T2D胰岛显示出可重复的应激/身份丢失框架，在研究级交叉拟合和β细胞分辨验证下具有方向性可推广性。候选面板是一种研究性转录组特征，需要进一步验证。
